name: ddd-expert
description: Purpose-led EventStorming, falsifiable Tactical Design, implementation, and review

interface.longDescription: DDD workflow that starts from the user's purpose, separates confirmed business facts from structural hypotheses, and invokes Tactical Design only for a material design gap. Tactical Design establishes object responsibilities, state authority, and semantic flow before technical sequences; Codify may test a draft through reversible implementation, and Guard reviews only the reconciled ready design.
defaultPrompt: Use $ddd-expert:event-storming to clarify the user's purpose and separate confirmed business facts from a falsifiable strategic model. Invoke $ddd-expert:tactical-design only for a real Design Delta; establish domain-object responsibilities, state authority, semantic flow, and necessity before technical sequences. Treat a Tactical Design draft as a candidate that $ddd-expert:codify may test reversibly, then reconcile the evidence before ready status and Guard.
